title: What is Lovable?

body.text: AI that builds web apps from a chat prompt (prompt-to-app)
. Just say what app you want and it builds the pages, buttons, forms, and logic right away. Great for people with ideas but no coding skills who want a working prototype fast.

example: Build a to-do list app with a field to add tasks, a checkbox to mark done, and delete — clean blue design

title: What is it good for?

body.text: landing pages, internal team apps, MVP prototypes, and small tools

you want quickly. Its strength is instant results and editing in plain language. It's not a replacement for a dev team on huge, very complex systems — but it gets ideas onto the web for real in minutes.

example: Build a landing page promoting an online course, with a headline, 3 key benefits, and a sign-up button
